Episode 162. Smarion Prochi(3)
About five hundred aura interference devices.

Over the last two years and six months, Kwa-ul believed that he had raised the performance of the interference devices and related artifacts to a level close to the limit, and there were numerous tests before reaching that conclusion.
So far, no comrade has been able to withstand five hundred interference devices.
Even without going up to five hundred, neither Valkas nor Quicantel could properly use aura while dealing with more than two hundred interference devices.
However, Jin was not affected by the interference devices at all.
On the contrary, as soon as the interference device was opened, he spread an enormous aura and even covered everyone waiting outside the battlefield with a new protective shield.
Just like Ron Hiran protected people from chaos in the Sword King's Palace.

'Ignoring all interference devices and providing individual shields to hundreds of people, it's something that cannot be done merely by having more than 10 star energy... It's not a human domain. You've turned into a monster, Jin.'
Quicantel unwittingly swallowed a dry spit.
The level of powerlessness Jin was showing now was shockingly high, even to her, who remembered the heyday of Murakan.
In some ways, she even thought that Jin had already become a more frightening existence than Murakan at that time.
With this growth rate, his combat power will soon reach Murakan, and his judgment and insight have been far beyond those of a young human since long ago.
Suddenly, a sullen glow flickered on the battlefield.
Smarion's energy, which had been superior to Jin's since the start of the battle, was being swallowed up by the aura and the thunderclouds.
'You treat me as nothing more than a beast. So, it's not a fight, but a hunt?'
Smarion showed a displeased expression and shot a sword energy towards the comrades.
However, the sword energy was disassembled in the air before even reaching the comrades' protective shield.
It was completely offset by Jin's energy spread layer by layer.
"It would be better to focus on me. Trying to threaten me through those on the outside will work against you."
Smarion, with his eyes wide open.
He no longer showed the leisure he had shown at the beginning, while Jin remained as composed as ever.
Jin was right. Trying to take his comrades as hostages while he couldn't even handle Jin properly was only an effective method until 'before' he arrived at Gyogoksa Castle.
Jin wondered why Smarion didn't do so. The explanation that it was just to realize his desire to fight with Shiron or such a kind of person was not enough.
'Maybe it's the result of Smarion resisting the Devilish nature. My comrades didn't die until I arrived.'
It was not a situation where they could calmly discuss this.
Whether the comrades were safe due to Smarion's resistance to the Devilish nature or not, the fact that he needed to be subjugated did not change.
Even if the former was true, it would be the result fervently hoped for by the last bit of humanity left in Smarion who was still in the Devilish nature.
'I seem to have underestimated you because I haven't been out in the world for a long time.'
Swoosh-!
An afterimage was left where Jin had stood. At the same time, Smarion's dual swords broke again, and he repelled Jin's sword, which was stabbing into his chest, with his bare fist.
A loud sound echoed from the collision between Bradamante and Smarion's fist.
The comrades were shivering from the heavy shock that was transmitted through the Guardian Brothers, the flame prevention curtain, the power of time, and various shields.
As they started to increase their speed, Smarion's body began to accrue afterimage wounds at a rapid rate.
Jin had not allowed a single effective hit since the interference devices were deployed.
Before long, Smarion changed his tactics.
'All attacks have become heavy. I can't win by dragging out the time, so I need to try to cut him at least once.'
The offense and defense of the elite are inevitably delicate and accurate.

Even though most of the insights Smarion had gained as a warrior during his ghost general days had become murky due to the Devilish nature, his sword still retained the unique finesse of the transcendents.
But now, Smarion was breaking even that remaining finesse himself. As soon as he judged that he couldn't win a head-to-head battle, he chose the sword of Dongguiying.
"Khaaak!"
Bradamante pierced through Smarion's left shoulder.
At the same time, Smarion thrust the sword in his right hand into Jin's chest.
The blade penetrated Jin's energy armor and dug into his chest about a finger's length.
On that blade was the chaos that Smarion had accumulated over decades.
A murky energy, which couldn't be compared with any poison in the world, quickly spread through Jin's body.
Smarion naturally expected Jin to be shocked and back away.
He thought Jin would cough up blood, break his waist somehow, and struggle to expel the chaos that had entered his body.
But Jin, without concern, detonated the sword stuck in Smarion's shoulder. Without showing any sign of being startled.
Jin is a Myungwang Tribe. Through this training, he has not only surpassed the concept of being a brother as a human but has also developed almost similar traits to them physically.
Unless it's the initial chaos used directly by Heluram, or a power equivalent to it, all types of 'ordinary chaos' in the world can no longer affect him. No matter how massive or dense it is.
'Unbelievable... What are you?'
"The last remaining trick didn't work.

Smarion, who had taken distance, panted with his left arm hanging. He had concentrated all his energy as soon as he touched the spiritual armor, but Jin didn't show signs of fatigue, let alone injury.
If he could somehow take care of Jin, even if he had only 10% of his strength left, he could have escaped and planned for the future.
But in fact, the fight was already over.
Smarion couldn't think of any more means to threaten Jin. Of course, it was impossible to take his comrades as hostages, and escape was also not the answer.
"You looked at me and found my father."
Jin, who was slowly stepping towards Smarion.
Smarion swung his sword in desperation, but Jin easily parried or repelled all the attacks, showing the difference in level.
"Surely you were much stronger in your days as a Ghost Captain than you are now, but you could not have been a match for my father."
It was only possible for Jin to say that Ghost Captain Smarion Prochi was stronger than he is now, drenched in devilishness.

Unless they were transcendents like Jin, they could never think like that. Because there is an area that can never be reached, filling the devilishness inside you instead of absolute calm. Even though the power may grow much more.
"But why, Sirion Runcandel, my father. I was curious why he left you alive at that time."
- Perhaps you don't know that my father had a duel with Sirion.
- My father and the former Ghost Captain...?
- I didn't see it myself. It happened before I was born. But that fight continued all day, and in the end, the victory was Sirion's, but for some reason, he did not take my father's life.

Even though Ghost Captain Smarion was strong enough to fight 'one day' with Sirion at that time, the devilishness was not controlled, and the Ghost Corps did not pledge loyalty to Runcandel even after losing the battle.
Instead, Sirion often visited Gwigoksaseong to check on Smarion's well-being.
"I have a vague guess as to why my father did that as I crossed swords with you."
[What are you talking about?]
"My father must have respected the fact that you were resisting chaos."
Resistance to chaos and respect for it.
In retrospect, there were many strange points in the fight between Jin and Smarion from the beginning.
Smarion had been able to open and come out of the seal long before Jin arrived.
Therefore, Smarion could have killed all the humans around him at any time before Jin arrived. Even if most of the strong men of Tikan were on standby, they couldn't match Smarion.
But Smarion didn't do that. Saying he was waiting for someone like Sirion.
Smarion's chaos exploded a few times and turned the whole area into a wasteland, and there were casualties in the process, but there was no decisive damage to the Tikan side."
Smarion concentrated all his chaos and slaughter, scattered all around the region, towards Jin only after Jin appeared.
From Jin's perspective, it felt inexplicable why Smarion would do so.
There's only one assumption, that is, 'Smarion resisted his demonic nature to prevent killing people'.

"I have come to believe that you were resisting chaos until I arrived. The dullness of your sword all along, and the fact that the Prochi siblings and my people did not die, I believe all were thanks to that."
In other words, Jin speculated that Smarion had let go of his last resistance as soon as an entity 'capable of killing him' appeared.
"Is it because you're a descendant of Shiron, spouting such arrogant nonsense?"

"That's why I want to pay my respects before I end the fight. Not to the monstrous creature of chaos standing before me now, but to the human Smarion Prochi who, until yesterday, had single-handedly defended the fortress of Gwigoksaseong from chaos."
Whoosh...!
The aura and pressure that had been engulfing the battlefield disappeared suddenly.
The daunting presence of Smarion, which had been bound by those, also disappeared with them.
The chaotic battlefield, where different powers were mixed, became quiet in an instant, and the ones starting to fill those spaces were none other than Jin's divine energy.
In the midst of it, chaos sprang up a few times like a spear, but like a stone thrown into the sea, it sunk powerlessly into the divine energy.
"Damn..."
Jin, who had halted his steps, pointed his Bradamante at Smarion.
There was no need to unleash the ultimate technique of his divine sword.
As if closing the eyes of the dead, gently, Bradamante pierced Smarion's chest.
Smarion twitched once, grasping the blade, while Jin silently watched his dying red eyes.
Smarion's gaze was not focused on Jin, who had pierced him, but beyond the darkness filled with divine energy.
In a life stained with madness and chaos, the only warm memories he had were when he held Rata and Faye. Although even those times eventually became eras of mutual abuse and violence.
It wasn't that Smarion was reminiscing about those times now.
As Jin had speculated, the moment he arrived, Smarion lost the last will of his human self.
Merely, the reason why Smarion's gaze fell on his children was just coincidence or a post-mortem spasm of the human Smarion.
However, in Jin's eyes, it seemed like a fateful result of Smarion's resistance against chaos.
"Rest in peace, Sir Smarion."
Eventually, the fallen Smarion disintegrated into particles, scattered among the divine energy that filled the battlefield, and Jin silently paid his respects at the place where he once stood.
